title: Jews and Judaism: Selected Historical Topics; What Did the Rabbis Think the Bible Really Means?
description:
Cross-listed with JWST419B and JWST469C. Credit only granted for HIST418C, JWST419B, or JWST469C.

Sacred texts like the Hebrew bible challenge human understanding, demanding constant study, interpretation and reinterpretation. Jewish scholars have been engaged in this process (exegesis) for centuries, trying to make the Bible give up its mysteries while blocking alternative interpretations that they thought unacceptable. Through close reading ofbiblical passages and rabbinic commentaries we will examine issues ranging from vegetarianism to messianism, gender to eros,the holiness of Jerusalem to the legitimacy of Halacha.
